summary: Backend: 25/25 pytest cases pass (auth, register+duplicate 409, consent, 12-question assessment with all-0 -> low & all-3 -> high with alert_created, missing answers 400, dashboard, wearable connect/disconnect, chat LLM (real gpt-5.4-mini call succeeded ~2-3s), support/request, therapist overview with anonymized MW-XXXX ids, alerts list + followup persistence, personnel detail, role-based 403). Frontend: Login (role segment, identifier-first flow, wrong-password error 'Invalid credentials'), Personnel Home for CRPF-1002 verified (score=81 HIGH, all home-* testIDs present, chart+attention banner+today grid render), Therapist dashboard verified (stats + filter chips + 5 anonymized personnel rows + alerts screen with follow-up buttons). Assessment submission proved end-to-end via backend (CRPF-1001 score jumped to 100/HIGH after 12x option-3 submission) but the result-screen UI + Chat/Wearable/Profile screens could not be fully verified through Playwright because an Expo/RN dev-mode LogBox full-screen ERROR overlay pops up as soon as the LineChart mounts (react-native-gifted-charts injects RN-only props like onPressOut/onStartShouldSetResponder that RN-Web classifies as errors). Deprecated packages / RN issues detected: react-native-gifted-charts triggering unknown-event-handler errors on web preview; deprecated 'shadow*' style props warning; 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning; 'TouchableMixin is deprecated' warning.

ui_bugs.issue: Full-screen 'Unknown event handler property onPressOut' console-error overlay from react-native-gifted-charts LineChart intercepts all taps on Home/Assessment result/Chat/Wearable/Profile screens in the web preview. Users on the deployed web preview see the error overlay and cannot interact until they dismiss it. Reproduce: log in as any personnel; the LineChart in components/stress-chart.tsx (line 25) triggers it.

issues: Layout, spacing and touch targets look good on 390x844 (buttons ~52px tall). No contrast issues.

react_native_issues.issue: Emits web-incompatible responder props (onStartShouldSetResponder, onResponderGrant/Move/Release/Terminate, onPressOut) causing RN-Web to log Console Errors that pop the LogBox full-screen overlay in dev mode. Reference: /app/frontend/components/stress-chart.tsx:25

Deprecation warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Search for `shadowColor`, `shadowOffset`, `shadowOpacity`, `shadowRadius` in the codebase and migrate to boxShadow on web / keep native-only via Platform.select.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Migrate any `<View pointerEvents=...>` to `<View style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}>`.
'TouchableMixin is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' Replace TouchableOpacity usages with Pressable.

action_items: Suppress the dev-mode LogBox error overlay in the root layout with `LogBox.ignoreLogs(['Unknown event handler property', 'shadow*', 'TouchableMixin', 'props.pointerEvents'])` so it does not cover the app in the web preview (this is the highest priority as it blocks all UI on the deployed preview).
Ideally wrap or replace the LineChart on web (Platform.OS === 'web') with a chart library that does not inject RN responder props, or filter those props before passing to gifted-charts on web.
Migrate deprecated APIs: shadow* -> boxShadow, pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents, TouchableOpacity -> Pressable.
Consider verifying via the fixed environment that the assessment-result screen, chat, wearable and profile flows render correctly after the LogBox is silenced.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 525 lines - within limits but consider extracting routers (auth, assessment, therapist, chat) into separate modules for maintainability.
Password bcrypt round=12 is good. JWT includes iss/exp/iat/sub/role and role is verified against DB on each request - solid.
MongoDB _id is consistently converted to string 'id' via from_mongo/serialize_assessment; no ObjectId leaks in responses.

Risk engine weights sum to 1.0 exactly (0.08+0.07+0.09+0.05+0.07+0.08+0.12+0.10+0.12+0.11+0.06+0.05 = 1.00) so max base score is 100. All-3 answers deterministically yield score 100 -> level high, all-0 -> 0 -> low; boundary buckets (<35 low, 35-<60 medium, >=60 high) match the spec.

chat endpoint stores the user message BEFORE calling LlmChat; if LLM raises, the user message is persisted but there is no assistant reply - reasonable but consider deleting the orphan user doc on failure.

success_rate.frontend: Login + Home + Therapist dashboard/alerts list verified (~60%); Assessment submission verified indirectly via backend + updated dashboard score; result screen, chat, wearable, profile UI not directly verifiable due to LogBox overlay

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the UI blocker: react-native-gifted-charts LineChart component (used inside components/stress-chart.tsx line 25) forwards native-only responder props (onStartShouldSetResponder, onResponderTerminationRequest, onResponderGrant/Move/Release/Terminate, onPressOut) to underlying <View> elements. React DOM does not recognise these, so react-native-web falls back to logging them as Console Errors via LogBox. In Expo dev mode any LogBox error auto-mounts a full-screen error dialog above the app root, blocking clicks. The errors are cosmetic (chart still renders fine underneath) - either silence LogBox in dev or filter the props before passing to LineChart on web. Prod builds strip LogBox so the issue only manifests in the current preview environment.
